challenges.resolution: faultMasksExactly proves complete mask membership at arbitrary width/depth. changedCountBound bounds wrong labels by mask length, changedCounts preserves width, majorityFromBudget proves strict majority at2d+1, and exhaustiveCorrection inducts over the complete ordered mask list.

challenges.challenge: Does joint composition silently assume a collision-free separator?
